scope: Runs two named TEI tests on this Windows host and records each verdict, keeping a SKIP separate from a PASS or FAIL. A skip means the host cannot produce the result the test is designed to show, so this establishes nothing about the behaviour under test. It does not substitute for the linux CI result, does not exercise a published Function, a real Provider call, or external harness receipt.
